brief:
The International Committee of the Red Crescent reported that thousands of families in Gaza remain unaware of the fate of their missing relatives, Shehab Wire (EN) said. Some families have been waiting nearly three years to learn what happened to their loved ones, the organization stated.

The committee did not specify the exact total number of missing persons or provide further details about the circumstances surrounding their disappearances. The situation underscores the humanitarian toll of prolonged conflict in the territory, where families continue to search for answers about relatives who vanished during earlier periods of violence.
